title: Filter Not Null
instructions:
Write a generic function called `filterNotNull` that takes a `List<T?>` (a list that might contain null values) and returns a `List<T>` with all the null values removed.

The function signature should be:
`fun <T> filterNotNull(items: List<T?>): List<T>`

Create a new mutable list. Loop through `items` and add each non-null item to the new list. Return the new list.

For example, `filterNotNull(listOf(1, null, 3, null, 5))` should return `[1, 3, 5]`.
hint: Create `val result = mutableListOf<T>()`. Loop through each item. Check `if (item != null)` and add it to the result. Return `result`.
